body_text:
The intersection of any family of subspaces of $V$ is a subspace.
The span of a subset $S$ is therefore the intersection of all
subspaces containing $S$, equivalently the set of all finite
linear combinations of elements of $S$. The word finite remains
essential even when $S$ is infinite.
